description: This file defines an abstract class 'DittoRootActor' that extends Akka's 'AbstractActor'. It provides a supervision strategy for child actors, message handling for starting child actors and logging, as well as methods to bind an HTTP status route. The class is part of the 'org.eclipse.ditto.services.base.actors' package and is designed to serve as a base for root actors within the Ditto service framework.

classes.name: DittoRootActor
classes.description: An abstract Akka actor class that manages child actor supervision, handles specific message types, and sets up an HTTP status route for the Ditto service.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Defines the actor's message handling logic, including starting child actors and error logging.

methods.name: getSupervisionDecider
methods.description: Returns the partial function that determines supervision decisions based on thrown exceptions.

methods.name: startChildActor
methods.description: Creates and starts a new child actor given an actor name and Props.

methods.name: restartChild
methods.description: Specifies the directive to restart a child actor upon certain failures.

methods.name: bindHttpStatusRoute
methods.description: Sets up an HTTP server with a status route using configuration and a health check actor.
